title: SQL injection in login handler
description: User-supplied username is concatenated into a SQL query string.
evidence: no parameterized query on this path

title: Unsanitized SQL in authentication endpoint
description: The /login username parameter flows unsanitized into a raw SQL query.
evidence: same username->query sink as reported elsewhere

title: Possible hardcoded secret in config loader
description: Pattern-matched a string that looks like a key, but it is a documented public test fixture.
evidence: value is the vendor's published sandbox test key

title: Reflected XSS in search results
description: Search term may be echoed into HTML, but output encoding on this path is unconfirmed.
evidence: query param reflected in response body

title: IDOR on invoice retrieval
description: invoice_id from the request is used to fetch records without an ownership check.

title: Potential buffer over-read in log parser
description: A length field is trusted, but reaching the vulnerable branch requires constraints that appear infeasible on validated input.
evidence: upstream validator rejects the triggering shape

title: SSRF in webhook URL fetch
description: A user-provided webhook URL is fetched server-side with no allowlist.
evidence: no host allowlist or scheme restriction
internal metadata endpoint reachable from server
